description: OAG sells commercial aviation data sets on global flights. Supply data include forward-looking and historical schedules from more than 900 airlines, updated every 15 minutes; real-time flight status with cancellations and delays; seats by cabin class on scheduled and operated flights, updated daily; every viable passenger connection across more than 200 million route combinations, updated weekly; minimum connection times; and master data on airline and airport codes, aircraft types and time zones. An archive holds more than 20 years of schedules, status and performance data, and demand products cover passenger bookings and airfares. OAG is a private aviation data company. Coverage is global. Data are delivered through cloud shares, data feeds and APIs as premium products. Caveats: the data are proprietary and sold, prices are not published, and the pages are marketing material without technical documentation. The schedules and connections support global air transport network models, airport capacity planning and disruption studies such as the spread of delays and cancellations. They complement the ICAO API data service and the IATA air transport statistics catalogued here.
